notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.2
notes.content:
Hi Everyone here are the new patch notes:

Added new Fruits.

Added a new languages(Russia, Spanish, German) these can be changed on the settings menu.

Added a new Tag System for fruits called Ascended.

Ascended Fruits can be obtained by crafting with 10 Ascended Fruits Bits, you have a small chance of getting these Bits every time you Chop a Fruit.

Thanks for your support and have fun.

notes.title: New Items / Compensation Item / Info Panel
notes.content:
Hi Everyone.

With the inventory issue now resolve I'm glad to announce the first patch of the game:

Added 2 new Unique rarity fruits one is a design made by a community member.

Added 1 Limited promotional item as compensation for the inventory issue, you will get 1 item when you open the game with the new update.

Added a Info panel where it says how the game in general works also it has information on the percentages for each drop and also how many bits you get from each rarity.

I'm already planning what else to add to the game like: More languages, Linux/Mac support, a panel where you can see exactly what dropped and on what time.

Thank you all if you have any feedback or design ideas for fruits leave it on the discord serve: [url=https://discord.gg/zWuB8be7jc]Link[/url]

notes.title: No Inventory / No drops (Fixed)
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

As you may already notice if you try to access this game Steam inventory it will tell you that it is Unavailable I have tried changing what i can on the steam settings but still its not working.
Also i have already contacted steam about this issue and still got no response, but for what i can see the drops and the inventory is working fine because you can see everything on the in-game Inventory, so i assume that the problem is on the steam side of things and i can't do nothing right now.

But because of this issue and some feedback that i have gotten i am working on a patch where i will add information panel in-game where you can see what have you last gotten on each drop, at what time and the estimated time for the next drop.
i will also activate a new item to be drop after the patch goes live as a compensation for the problems.

I'm truly sorry for the problems i try to do my best and will keep working on this game and improving it in every way i can.

Edit: The issue is now fixed you can see your inventory the patch should be coming tomorrow (July 11).
